region_not_found.title: EON Energiemonitor: Invalid region_code
region_not_found.description: region_code "{region_code}" was not found by the EON API. Resolve your code with: `curl -s "https://api-energiemonitor.eon.com/region-data?regionUrlKey=<slug>"` where `<slug>` is the last path segment of your municipality dashboard URL. Configure the numeric `regionCode` in configuration.yaml under `eon-energiemonitor:`.

update_failed.title: EON Energiemonitor: No data
update_failed.description: Update failed ({error}). Check network connectivity, region_code, and Home Assistant logs (filter: eon_energiemonitor).

scope_region_not_found.title: EON Energiemonitor ({alias}): Invalid region_code
scope_region_not_found.description: scope alias "{alias}": region_code "{region_code}" was not found by the EON API. Resolve via `region-data?regionUrlKey=<slug>` or `region-data?tenantId=<id>`. See doc/SCOPE_SPEC.md.

scope_update_failed.title: EON Energiemonitor ({alias}): No data
scope_update_failed.description: scope alias "{alias}": update failed ({error}). Check network, region_code, and Home Assistant logs (filter: eon_energiemonitor).
